Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner changed the methodology mid-task to count only blue-linked Wikipedia names and to include touring members, which deviates from the stated goal of counting official band members across each band’s history. This led to undercounting Letters to Cleo and overcounting Screaming Trees (by including touring-only members like Dan Peters and Donna Dresch), producing the incorrect conclusion that Screaming Trees had more members instead of Letters to Cleo.
